from scipy.optimize import fsolve

# Target measurements
target_nb1_x1 = 5.0
target_nb1_x2 = 13.333
target_x1_x2 = 18.333

# Delta configuration: R1 (N_b1-X1), R2 (N_b1-X2), R3 (X1-X2)
# Constraint: one resistor is twice another

# Try all combinations
def test_delta(R1, R2, R3):
    nb1_x1 = R1 * (R2 + R3) / (R1 + R2 + R3)
    nb1_x2 = R2 * (R1 + R3) / (R1 + R2 + R3)
    x1_x2 = R3 * (R1 + R2) / (R1 + R2 + R3)
    return nb1_x1, nb1_x2, x1_x2

# R3 = 2*R2
def eq_r3_2r2(vars):
    R1, R2 = vars
    R3 = 2 * R2
    nb1_x1, nb1_x2, x1_x2 = test_delta(R1, R2, R3)
    return [nb1_x1 - target_nb1_x1, nb1_x2 - target_nb1_x2]

# R3 = 2*R1
def eq_r3_2r1(vars):
    R1, R2 = vars
    R3 = 2 * R1
    nb1_x1, nb1_x2, x1_x2 = test_delta(R1, R2, R3)
    return [nb1_x1 - target_nb1_x1, nb1_x2 - target_nb1_x2]

# R2 = 2*R1
def eq_r2_2r1(vars):
    R1, R3 = vars
    R2 = 2 * R1
    nb1_x1, nb1_x2, x1_x2 = test_delta(R1, R2, R3)
    return [nb1_x1 - target_nb1_x1, nb1_x2 - target_nb1_x2]

# R2 = 2*R3
def eq_r2_2r3(vars):
    R1, R3 = vars
    R2 = 2 * R3
    nb1_x1, nb1_x2, x1_x2 = test_delta(R1, R2, R3)
    return [nb1_x1 - target_nb1_x1, nb1_x2 - target_nb1_x2]

# R1 = 2*R2
def eq_r1_2r2(vars):
    R2, R3 = vars
    R1 = 2 * R2
    nb1_x1, nb1_x2, x1_x2 = test_delta(R1, R2, R3)
    return [nb1_x1 - target_nb1_x1, nb1_x2 - target_nb1_x2]

# R1 = 2*R3
def eq_r1_2r3(vars):
    R2, R3 = vars
    R1 = 2 * R3
    nb1_x1, nb1_x2, x1_x2 = test_delta(R1, R2, R3)
    return [nb1_x1 - target_nb1_x1, nb1_x2 - target_nb1_x2]

scenarios = [
    ("R3 = 2*R2", eq_r3_2r2, [10, 10]),
    ("R3 = 2*R1", eq_r3_2r1, [10, 10]),
    ("R2 = 2*R1", eq_r2_2r1, [10, 10]),
    ("R2 = 2*R3", eq_r2_2r3, [10, 10]),
    ("R1 = 2*R2", eq_r1_2r2, [10, 10]),
    ("R1 = 2*R3", eq_r1_2r3, [10, 10]),
]

for name, eq_func, init in scenarios:
    print(f"\nTesting {name}:")
    try:
        sol = fsolve(eq_func, init)
        
        if name == "R3 = 2*R2":
            R1, R2 = sol
            R3 = 2 * R2
        elif name == "R3 = 2*R1":
            R1, R2 = sol
            R3 = 2 * R1
        elif name == "R2 = 2*R1":
            R1, R3 = sol
            R2 = 2 * R1
        elif name == "R2 = 2*R3":
            R1, R3 = sol
            R2 = 2 * R3
        elif name == "R1 = 2*R2":
            R2, R3 = sol
            R1 = 2 * R2
        elif name == "R1 = 2*R3":
            R2, R3 = sol
            R1 = 2 * R3
        
        if R1 > 0 and R2 > 0 and R3 > 0:
            print(f"R1={R1:.4f}, R2={R2:.4f}, R3={R3:.4f}")
            nb1_x1, nb1_x2, x1_x2 = test_delta(R1, R2, R3)
            print(f"N_b1-X1={nb1_x1:.4f} (target={target_nb1_x1})")
            print(f"N_b1-X2={nb1_x2:.4f} (target={target_nb1_x2})")
            print(f"X1-X2={x1_x2:.4f} (target={target_x1_x2})")
            
            error = abs(nb1_x1 - target_nb1_x1) + abs(nb1_x2 - target_nb1_x2) + abs(x1_x2 - target_x1_x2)
            print(f"Total error: {error:.6f}")
        else:
            print("Negative resistance - invalid solution")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed: {e}")
